title: Switching astronaut chem lights from red to green

tellings.quote: it took me a year and a half to to get NASA to switch to the green chem lights.

plain: A doctor named Greg Rogers, who worked with NASA (the US space agency) at Kennedy Space Center in Florida around 1989 to 1991, says it took him a year and a half to get NASA to switch the glow sticks carried for astronauts from red to green. He tells it from his own experience and mentions a Colonel Shokitis in the story, as an example of how slowly the agency changed its ways.
